description: This study reconstructs the July 2017 Jetpura dam breach in Gujarat using HEC-HMS, HEC-RAS and terrain and remote-sensing inputs. It reports flood maps and environmental-impact estimates. The metadata is published or maintained by Indra Prakash; Dhruvesh Patel; Uttamkumar Vyas and coauthors (provider deposit/publication). Coverage is at site scale in India. Any further spatial resolution, complete time span or sampling interval beyond the details above is not verified here. The application is documented through a public PDF report; availability of its underlying model inputs is not established. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The inspected public record or source repository is free to read; this does not grant rights beyond its stated licence. Caveats: Independent reuse and ongoing maintenance were not established; admission depends on the open single-study rule. For infrastructure simulation, its documented contents can support hazard exposure. These are catalogue-use assessments, not additional validation claims. The provider describes HEC-RAS River Analysis System. Related catalogue records are model-hec-ras.
